a1-158.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Are You From?
a1-158.scenario: Anna asks you (Meg) what nationality you are and where your family lives. You are English, and your family lives in England.
a1-158.prompt: Tell Anna your nationality and the country where your family lives.
cues: Say which country your family lives in
a1-158.target: Angol vagyok. A családom Angliában lakik.
a1-158.english: I am English. My family lives in England.
a1-158.canDo: I can say my nationality, like Magyar vagyok and Meg angol.

a1-159.title: Communicative Challenge: What Does It Mean?
a1-159.scenario: In the café Károly uses a Hungarian word that you (Meg) do not know. You tell him so, ask what it means and how to say it in English.
a1-159.prompt: Tell Károly that you do not understand, ask what it means and how to say it in English.
cues: Say that you do not understand
Ask how to say it in English
a1-159.target: Nem értem. Mit jelent ez? Hogy mondják angolul?
a1-159.english: I don't understand. What does this mean? How do you say it in English?
a1-159.canDo: I can say I do not understand and ask someone to repeat, like Nem értem and Még egyszer, légy szíves.

a1-160.title: Communicative Challenge: Practising Together
a1-160.scenario: At the language exchange in the café Anna sits down at your table. You (Meg) are learning Hungarian, and you would like to practise with her.
a1-160.prompt: Tell Anna which language you are learning and ask if you practise together.
cues: Say which language you are learning
a1-160.english: I am learning Hungarian. Shall we practise together?
a1-160.canDo: I can offer to practise a language together, like Gyakorolunk együtt?
